name: Grinm Advanced Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Grinm Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of advanced materials in China and internationally. The company offers Cu and Cu, and Al and Al alloy series; Ti and Ti Coil; W, WTi, Ta, and Ta Coil; Co, Au, Ag, NiPt, NiV, AlSc, CuP, and other metals; Ni, Pt, Sn, Cr, and other basic full-size evaporation pellets and cone; and gold tin solder pads, gold germanium solder pads, and gold tin solder paste. It also provides gold, platinum, palladium, rhodium, iridium, ruthenium, silver, and silver-palladium alloy powders; platinum, gold, silver, silver palladium, and ruthenium paste; platinum tungsten alloy ultrafine, platinum nickel alloy ultrafine…
